Theme

Latin word

quid

pronoun, declension

something, anything (after sī, nisi, num, nē); what?; why? what … for?

In this lexicon

  • something

    also used · classical · Col. 12.2.6: sī quid forte abest; Cic. Att. 15.16a: sī quid scrībere velīs

  • what

    the recommended word · classical · Ter. And. 139: Quid fēcī?; Cic. Att. 7.11.1: quaesō, quid est hoc?; Traupman 406

  • why

    also used · classical · Hor. S. 1.1.69: quid rīdēs?; Ter. And. 979: Quid stās? quid cessās?

  • Scīn' quid …?: do you know what?

  • Nōn quis sed quid.: it’s not who you are but what you are that counts

    modern

    classical

    classical

    classical

    classical

  • quid faciam?: shall

    classical

  • nesciō quid: something

    classical

    classical

  • Mihi dīc quid acciderit.: tell me what happened

    classical

    classical
